judgment.explanation: 本 is the personal name of 陳本 (Chen Ben), a historical figure from Guangling. The main text identifies him as 廣陵陳本, and the Liu annotation confirms 本字休元, 廣陵東陽人, son of 司徒 (Sima). The candidate c0 is the local person form for 本, matching the historical Chen Ben.

玄 is the personal name of 夏侯泰初 (Xiahou Xuan / Xiahou Taichu). The main text opens with 夏侯泰初 and later uses 玄 as his personal name. The Liu annotation (名士傳曰玄以鄉黨貴) confirms 玄 refers to Xiahou Xuan. The candidate c0 is the prior candidate for 夏侯泰初, matching the historical Xiahou Xuan.

騫 is the personal name of Chen Ben's younger brother, Chen Qian (陳騫). The main text says 本弟騫, and the Liu annotation confirms 騫字休淵, 司徒第二子. The candidate c0 is the local person form for 騫, matching the historical Chen Qian.
